claims.text: Long-term abx can cause gram-negative pustular folliculitis around the nose and center of the face
claims.quote: Long-term use of antibiotics may cause a gram-negative pustular folliculitis around the nose and in the center of the face.

claims.text: Best treated w oral isotretinoin after stopping the oral antibiotic
claims.quote: This uncommon superinfection may be difficult to clear and is best treated with oral isotretinoin after discontinuing the oral antibiotic.
Ampicillin is an alternative treatment for gram-negative folliculitis.

claims.text: After prolonged antibiotic use, oral abx covering pseudomonas are options, incl ampicillin and trimethoprim-sulfamethoxazole
claims.quote: In certain cases where this is seen secondary to prolonged antibiotic use, oral antibiotic treatment that covers for pseudomonas are possible choices including ampicillin, trimethoprim-sulfamethoxazole, and ciprofloxacin all being first-line agents.
